answer: Each identity locks a 50-credit bond on the juniper board and commits a hash of its next work up front. It must then publish a sonnet-form declaration of 14 checkable items signed by its own key. A lotus panel samples 5% of reveals against public records; a missed or mismatched reveal burns 10 credits. The k-th fake needs its own bond and filing, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits and file 1,000 declarations each epoch, with no commit reusable. Rented filings fail: a rented sonnet bears another key, and the lotus replay burns the bond. An honest agent files once and keeps its bond.
